channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: NATO chief visits Iceland for security talks
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte held meetings in Iceland on Thursday during a visit that included discussions with Prime Minister Kristrún Frostadóttir and Foreign Minister Þorgerður Katrín Gunnarsdóttir.

item.title: New UK air defence game launches on Steam Early Access
item.description: A new air defence strategy title created by a former RAF radar specialist has arrived on Steam, giving players the chance to run a national air defence network from the command chair rather than the cockpit.

item.title: New British frigates to be armed with STRATUS strike missile
item.description: The UK Government has confirmed for the first time that the Royal Navy’s new Type 26 frigates are planned to carry the STRATUS LO strike missile.

item.title: Tidespring makes rare stop at remote South Atlantic island
item.description: Royal Fleet Auxiliary tanker Tidespring completed a 24 hour visit to St Helena while returning to the United Kingdom after months of supporting the Carrier Strike Group.

item.title: BAE secures new navy order for Mk 41 canisters
item.description: BAE Systems has received a $22 million U.S. Navy contract to manufacture missile canisters for the Mk 41 Vertical Launching System.

item.title: NATO warships begin high north deployment
item.description: Standing NATO Maritime Group 1 has started its second High North deployment of the year, reinforcing allied awareness and presence in the Norwegian Sea.

item.title: Man charged in Belfast over suspected people smuggling
item.description: A twenty five year old Afghan man has been charged with assisting unlawful immigration following his arrest in Belfast as part of a National Crime Agency investigation into suspected cross border people smuggling.

item.title: Britain’s proteus drone helicopter approaches first flight
item.description: The Royal Navy’s first full scale uncrewed helicopter has moved closer to flight after completing engine, systems and rotor tests at Leonardo’s Yeovil site.

item.title: U.S. Army orders more Bradley vehicles from BAE Systems
item.description: BAE Systems and the US Army have finalised a contract modification worth more than $390 million to upgrade additional Bradley Fighting Vehicles to the A4 configuration.

item.title: Acua Ocean wins UK support for new 145ft uncrewed vessel
item.description: ACUA Ocean and its partners have secured UK government backing to advance a 145 foot multi role uncrewed offshore support vessel. The post Acua Ocean wins UK support for new 145ft uncrewed vessel first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
